[18F]F(97% β+, 0.64 Mev, T1/2 = 109 min) has a suitable half-life for peptide labeling and a shorter β+-trajectory (<2 mm), leading to excellent imaging resolution. “AlF” technology seems superior to “SiFA” technology as its advantages of one-step reaction, and radiolabeling in aqueous solution rather than in organic solvent, which decreased the influence of residual solvent for safety. [18F]AlF-NOTA-JR11 specifically binds to SSTR2 with high affinity and is used for PET/MR(positron emission tomography and magnetic resonance) imaging.
